conflicts.description: The Galewardens insist the ancient lattice must be preserved exactly as woven, while the Stormwright Compact argues that only a redesigned skybridge network can prevent the islands from scattering.
conflicts.name: The Bridge Doctrine Divide

conflicts.description: The Veyran Freeholders refuse to release their strongest bridge fibers until the other enclaves recognize their sovereignty, leaving critical repairs unfinished as their own island lists toward the cloud sea.
conflicts.name: The Veyran Harvest Embargo

conflicts.description: The Cartographers' Circle claims the failing spans point to a hidden anchor beneath Serra's Crown, but activating it would require every faction to surrender control of its most guarded rites.
conflicts.name: The Anchor Sovereignty Crisis

description: Aeloria is a fractured realm of floating islands scattered across luminous cloud seas and bound together by ancient skybridges. Each enclave preserves a different fragment of the lost knowledge that once held the archipelago in a stable formation. Now the bridges are failing, the islands are drifting out of alignment, and old rivalries threaten every attempt at repair. A young cartographer's discovery that the decay follows a deliberate pattern sets rival enclaves on a collision course between denial, ambition, and survival. Wondrous flying vessels, singing bridge-rites, storm spirits, and impossible geography create a realm where maps are both sacred records and acts of hope.

factions.description: Mapmakers and navigators from Lumin Vale who believe the islands' drift can be predicted if the hidden geometry of the skybridge network is fully charted.
factions.name: The Cartographers' Circle

factions.description: Hereditary keepers of the Anchor Court who maintain the central bridge lattice. They guard ancient rites fiercely and distrust any attempt to alter the original weave.
factions.name: The Galewardens

factions.description: Orchard clans and fiber-growers who supply the organic cords used in bridge repairs. They demand sovereignty and fair tribute before releasing their dwindling harvests.
factions.name: The Veyran Freeholders

factions.description: Engineers, sailors, and resonance-smiths of Kaelith Reach who favor bold reconstruction over preservation. Their leaders believe only a newly tuned skybridge system can save the realm.
factions.name: The Stormwright Compact

history.description: The original landmass split into hundreds of islands during a cataclysm remembered only through conflicting songs and fragmented maps.
history.name: The Shattering of Terra

history.description: The first anchor-keepers joined the largest islands with a resonant skybridge lattice, transforming scattered survivors into a shared realm.
history.name: The First Weaving

history.description: The enclaves agreed to share charts, fibers, metals, and anchor rites after a generation of drift storms nearly isolated them forever.
history.name: The Gale Accord

history.description: A minor bridge failed without warning and carried an entire outer island beyond recovery, fueling suspicion that the old lattice was beginning to unravel.
history.name: Collapse of the Mirren Span

history.description: A harmonic shock passed through Serra's Crown and appeared simultaneously on cartographic instruments across Aeloria, revealing that the failures formed a deliberate pattern.
history.name: The Crown Tremor

locations.description: A terraced island of glass-green fields and lantern-lit libraries, home to the cartographers who chart the archipelago's shifting currents. Its observatory towers catch moonlight through prisms and project constellation-maps across the mist.
locations.name: Lumin Vale

locations.description: A low-drifting island of orchards, rope farms, and hidden root caverns. Its people harvest cloudfruit and resilient skybridge fibers, but recent tremors have tilted whole groves toward the open sky.
locations.name: Veyra Hollow

locations.description: A windswept island of shipyards, kite towers, and resonant metalworks. Its stormwrights build sailcraft and tuning forks that can test a bridge's stability by listening to its harmonic song.
locations.name: Kaelith Reach

locations.description: The archipelago's highest island and the meeting point of its oldest skybridge lattice. Crystal spires rise around the Anchor Court, where enclave envoys negotiate beneath bridges braided into a single radiant knot.
locations.name: Serra's Crown

name: The Drifts of Aeloria

rules.statement: Every island moves along invisible currents of upper-air pressure; without tension from the skybridge network, an island gradually drifts beyond safe sailing range.
Each skybridge is a living lattice that holds because its anchor stones resonate in harmony; a discordant bridge weakens neighboring spans even when they appear intact.
Bridge anchors respond to sung rites, mapped star-alignments, and materials grown or forged on the islands they connect.
No enclave may alter another island's anchor stone without consent, making cooperation legally and spiritually essential to repairs.
Travel between islands depends on sailcraft, lift-kites, gliders, and resonance engines shaped by local winds rather than explosive propulsion.
